;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[2019 El Paso shooting]]
**At least 22 people are killed and 24 others injured in a [[mass shooting]] at a [[Walmart]] in [[El Paso, Texas]]. A suspect Patrick Crusius of [[Allen, Texas]] was captured alive. The case is being investigated as [[Domestic terrorism in the United States|domestic terrorism]] given that Patrick Crusius had posted a 4-page [[white nationalist]] manifesto titled ''The Inconvenient Truth'' on [[8chan]] where he cited a supposed "[[Hispanic and Latino Americans|Hispanic]] invasion of [[Texas]]" and "Simply trying to defend my country from [[White genocide conspiracy theory|cultural and ethnic replacement]]" as motivation for the shooting. The suspect was also inspired by Brenton Tarrant, the perpetrator of the [[Christchurch mosque shooting]] in [[New Zealand]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2019/08/05/us/el-paso-shooting-monday/index.html (CNN)]
*[[India]]n authorities issue evacuation orders for thousands of people, including tourists and [[Hindus|Hindu]] [[pilgrim]]s heading to the [[Amarnath Temple]] for [[yatra]] (which has been cancelled) to immediately leave [[Jammu and Kashmir (state)|Jammu and Kashmir]] because of security alerts about possible militant attacks. Also, the pilgrimage to [[Machel Mata]] for yatra, which also began on 1 July, has been suspended. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-india-49222571 (BBC News)] [https://www.news18.com/news/india/dont-panic-jammu-kashmir-governor-tells-political-parties-as-tourists-and-pilgrims-leave-valley-2256657.html (CNN-News18)]

;International relations
*[[Argentina–United States relations]]
**[[President of Argentina|Argentine President]] [[Mauricio Macri]] receives the [[United States Secretary of Commerce|U.S. Commerce Secretary]] [[Wilbur Ross]], who expresses full support from the U.S. for his re-election in the [[2019 Argentine general election|upcoming Argentine elections]]. [https://www.lanacion.com.ar/politica/sin-titulo-nid2273928 (''La Nación'')]

;Politics and elections
*[[2018–19 Sudanese protests]], [[2019 Sudanese transition to democracy]]
**The [[African Union]] announces the [[Transitional Military Council (2019)|Sudanese military council]] and the opposition agreed to a constitutional declaration that will pave the way to a new transitional government. It calls for the new government to be headed by six civilians and five generals, and formally places the [[Rapid Support Forces]] under military command. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-49213901 (BBC News)]
*Several hundred people are detained by [[police of Russia|Russian police]] at unauthorized protests in Moscow. The protests occurred because several opposition candidates were disqualified from running in the upcoming [[2019 Moscow City Duma election|Moscow City legislative election]]. [https://www.rt.com/russia/465731-moscow-unsanctioned-protest-opposition/ (RT)]

**[[Mitchie Brusco]] becomes the first [[skateboarder]] in history to complete a 1260° (3½-revolution [[aerials (skateboarding)|aerial spin]]) in competition. [https://www.cbssports.com/general/news/watch-american-mitchie-brusco-lands-first-ever-1260-in-skateboarding-at-x-games/ (CBS Sports)]
